publisher: Junta de Planificación de Puerto Rico (JP)
filter: municipio = 'Las Marías' AND cuerdas >= 10 AND cali_2021 <> 'VIAL'
notes: JP official statewide calificación layer, Las Marías only. Filter keeps polygons of 10+ cuerdas and drops road (VIAL) polygons because the full ~6,900-polygon set is too dense for the server to page within time limits; smaller districts are omitted.
